messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — Auriga dedicated bring-up checklist. Customer wants a predictable reserved pool w/ autoscale. Planned smoke/load test window Wed 10-12 PT. Key ask: confirm quota numbers, autoscale policy, KMS key handoff, and SE prompt set readiness. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auriga-dedicated

Tim (Ops): Ack. I'll reserve the slot on compute-pool-3 for Wed. Suggest initial autoscale target at 60% GPU util instead of 70% for first bake. Do we have their expected qps profile?

Maria (CS): Profile attached in onboarding doc, but TLDR: steady 150 reqs/min with bursts to 400 for 15m windows. Desired steady tokens/sec ~1200, burst up to 1800. If we start at 60% we should still meet SLOs. Also note renewal signal: if onboarding completes this month there's an upsell opportunity; if warmup slips >2 weeks we flag as renewal risk.

Rachel (SE): I will assemble the golden prompt set and acceptance criteria. Which model variant are we serving? Are we using quantized v1-8 or full fp16 for this run? Need to test quality delta.

Kevin (Infra): KMS note: Auriga will supply a customer-managed key. Ask them to create key and grant our service account redwood-inference-cust@project. To test locally, use this snippet:

```
export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=projects/auriga-prod/locations/global/keyRings/auriga-kr/cryptoKeys/auriga-key
# startup will pick up REDWOOD_KMS_KEY from env
```

Kevin (Infra): Also confirm if they require HSM-backed keys. If yes, we need approval from security and extra lead time for key provisioning.

Tim (Ops): Reserving pool and will run a staged soak: 30m ramp, 1h steady, 30m spike. We'll push shadow traffic first to validate caching and prefix hits. Post results to the drive and ping here. Fallback plan: if latency degrades, route 10% traffic to smaller quantized model.

Maria (CS): Good. Rachel, please include regen checks for hallucination rate and token efficiency in your eval. Also capture any customer UX asks so we can loop into enablement.

Rachel (SE): Roger. Will prepare eval harness and a short enablement doc for the customer's engineering team. ETA end of day Tue.

sched-bot: Reminder scheduled load test: Auriga dedicated bakeoff on 2025-03-26 17:00 UTC.

Tim (Ops): Confirmed. Postmortem template will be shared after the run with latency percentiles, error counts, and utilization heatmap. I'll include the autoscale policy we tested.

Maria (CS): Thanks all — final ask: capture any post-run feedback in the onboarding doc under the feedback section so Customer Success can surface renewal or enablement needs. :thumbsup:

Rachel (SE): Will do.

Kevin (Infra): One more thing — if the customer wants to rotate keys mid-warmup, we need a maintenance window. Call that out to them now to avoid surprises.

Maria (CS): Noted; I'll message the customer and ask for key rotation constraints.
